translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Bab Dummad anmar-abonossoggu, anmar nued nanamalar-gebed
Tito, gwenadganga gannar be sogo, insamaloye, dulemar-neg-semamaimalad, degine, amar-e-dummagan-urbaligwaa nanamaloye, degine, amar-sogedba damaloye, deginbali, ibmar-nueganbi-imakbi be itomaloye.
Mer dulemargi ichakwa sunmakoye, mer gadi urwed amied-saoye. Suli, degisuli. Bur dulemar-sabedba binnalee be ibmar imakmaloed, bela dulemar-baigan-urbaligwaa daed na be imakmaloed.

Ar anmar epenne deyob gudigusmogad, binsaed-suli, Bab-Dummadba-ibmar-imaksuli, yardakles-gudii, ibmar-iskana-maiga gudii, degine, ibmar-iskanagi wergudii, ibmar-iskanagi binsadii, nobgudii, dulemar istar anmar-dakdii, degine, muchub-muchub na istar-dakdimala anmar gusmalad.
Ar Bab Dummad, anmar-Abonoged, e-nued-dulemargi-binsaed, degine, bela dulemar-sabgued dulemarse oyolenonigu,

Bab Dummad anmar-abonononikid, anmar ibmar-igar-maidba inikii imaksadbarsulid, suli, deyobsulid. Anmar-abonononikid, wile anmar-daksadba anmarga iskued-elinonikid. Gannar anmar burbar gwalulenonikid, Bab Dummad Burba Nued anmarga burba-bini-uksadgi.
Anmar-Abonoged, Jesucristo, agi Bab Dummad anmarga E-Burba-Nued unnitiba uknonikid,
adi Bab Dummad anmargi-nabir-binsamaidba iskussuliyob anmar-daknonikidgi, anmar igar-nikunonimalad, burba-geg-bergued bensuli edarbediid abingaegar.

We-gaya-burba napiragwadid. We gaya-burbagi nue-gandikidba odurdaknai an be-abeged, adi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-bensurmalad ibmar-nueganbi imakbi-gumalagar. We-ibmarmar, ibmar-nueganad, degine, dulemarga ibmar-nueganga gubalid.

Ar ibmargi binsa ee sunmaklemaladgindi, dadgan-danimaladgindi, muchub-muchub na abin-abin imakmaladgindi, Moisés-igar-mesisadgi na abin-abin urwemaladgindi, mer be sunmakdii-guo, ar we ibmarmardi binsaledid, gwen ibmar-nueganga guosulid.
Ar dule-wargwen dulemar-danar-arbaed mamardiile, ese be goloed, irbo-goledgi be-itosulile, a-dulegi be banguoed.
Ar be wisid, we-dule degi-daedi, iskudiid, galagwensuli gudiid, ar na e-daedbali bato odurdakleged-igar ega megisdo.
Artemas an bese barmisar, igi, Tíquico an bese barmido-dibe, be gwae anse Nicópolis-neggweburse daged-sao, ar ade a-neggweburgi di-wied-nigi an mai-guoed.
Zenas, igarmar-mamaid-oduloged, degine, Apolos, amarga ibmar be ukmalo, adi neggwebur-baidsik nadmalar, melle ibmar sate igarba gumalagar.
Degine, anmar-sordamarmode durdaked samarmogoed ibmar-nuegan saed, dulemar-ibmarsurmaladga ibmar-nuegan imakega, adi mer binsa Bab-Jesúsba nanadii-gumalagar.
Bela an-walik-bukmalad bega sogsimardo bemarde nued sogeye. Dulemar-Jesúsgi-bensurmalad-anmar-sabmaladga be sogo bemar nued sogeye. Bab Dummad bitigi nued bemargi binsamalana-gadin. Be itogua.
